name: Plate Reader Kinetic Test
description: Minimal plate-reader integration test: load a plate, run a short A490 kinetic schedule (25 C, 30 s reads for 3 min), export once, and unload. Use in sim or on hardware to validate Gen5 kinetic AutoGUI wiring before the full TEM-1 screen.

inputs.name: assay_plate
inputs.description: 96-well plate to load into the reader (any plate with buffer or blanks is fine).

inputs.name: platereader
inputs.description: Plate reader used for A490 kinetic readout.

inputs.name: plate_home
inputs.description: Home fixture where the plate starts and returns after the read.

inputs.name: kinetic_second_read_s
inputs.description: Second A490 read time after kinetic t0 (seconds).

inputs.name: kinetic_total_time_s
inputs.description: End of kinetic read window after kinetic t0 (seconds). 180 = 3 min.

inputs.name: reader_temperature_c
inputs.description: Plate reader incubator setpoint (C); recorded for Gen5 programming.

inputs.name: reader_equilibration_s
inputs.description: Seconds at setpoint after lid close before the first kinetic read.

inputs.name: slope_window_start_s
inputs.description: Start of slope-fit window (kinetic time, seconds).

inputs.name: slope_window_end_s
inputs.description: End of slope-fit window (kinetic time, seconds).

inputs.name: run_name
inputs.description: Name for this run's saved output folder.

nodes.label: Grab Test Plate
nodes.description: Pick up the plate from its home fixture.

nodes.label: Load Plate Reader
nodes.description: Load the plate into the reader.

nodes.label: Close Plate Reader
nodes.description: Close the lid before the kinetic read.

nodes.label: Run Short Kinetic Schedule
nodes.description: 25 C, 30 s equilibration, A490 every 30 s for 3 min (7 reads). Triggers one Gen5 kinetic method.

nodes.label: Open Reader After Read
nodes.description: Open the reader so the plate can be unloaded.

nodes.label: Unload Plate Reader
nodes.description: Pick the plate out of the reader.

nodes.label: Return Test Plate
nodes.description: Return the plate to its home fixture.

nodes.label: Save Run Folder
nodes.description: Bundle the run log and plate-reader export.
